item.summary: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry organised outreach initiatives in Jaipur and Dehradun on 27 November 2026 to familiarise exporters, entrepreneurs and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) with opportunities arising from India’s Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) and facilitate greater access to international markets.
item.title: Commerce Ministry Organises Series of Workshops on Opportunities Arising from Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)
